nvitk.db.variable_units
=======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.variable_units

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Register measurement variable units in the catalog from curated metadata and table data.

----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.db.variable_units.LogFn

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: LogFn

.. py:data:: MEASUREMENT_TABLE_DOMAINS
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:data:: CURATED_VARIABLE_UNITS
   :type:  list[dict[str, Any]]

.. py:function:: _harvest_units_from_table(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, table: str) -> dict[str, str]

   Derive a ``{variable_id: unit}`` map from *table*'s recorded ``unit`` values, taking the most
   common non-empty unit per variable; empty if the table is missing or has no ``unit`` data.


.. py:function:: _catalog_variable_lookup(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]

   Build a ``{variable_id: entry}`` map from the catalog's registered variable entries.


.. py:function:: register_all_variable_units(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, *, log: LogFn = print) -> int

   Fill catalog ``unit`` fields from parquet data and curated overrides.
